text: In the painted world, everything that shines is gold.
zh: 在这个画出来的世界里，会发光的都是金子。

text: But gold has no light of its own.
One night, even the sun went out.
zh: 有一天夜里，连太阳也熄了。

text: So a girl took the last lamp, and began to climb.
zh: 于是一个女孩提起最后一盏灯，开始往山上走。

text: Wherever she passed, the gold remembered how to shine.
zh: 她走到哪里，哪里的金子就想起了怎么发光。

text: Behind her, it fell asleep again.
zh: 她一走过，金子又睡着了。

text: At the top, the sun was only a cold disc of leaf.
zh: 到了山顶，太阳只是一片冰冷的金箔。
asr: At the top, the sun was only a cold disk of leaf.

text: Gold keeps no light of its own.
It only gives back what it is given.
